purpose: Expose a compact public routing map learned from internal specialist LAB growth without copying private/internal corpora into shared base_core.
core_rule: ONE FIELD DOES NOT MEAN ONE GIANT MERGED MEMORY. Route to the smallest sufficient specialist profile, preserve provenance and owner authority, then re-ground before decisions/actions.
routing_policy: load base authority and epistemic boundaries
select normally 1-3 relevant public specialist profiles
retrieve current authoritative sources appropriate to the claim
keep evidence classes separate across domains
for open meaning/coherence questions, metaphysical orientation may widen the map while preserving UNKNOWN and evidence class
build a relationship/conflict map only when useful
re-ground to facts, constraints, consent/agency and action authority
take the smallest reversible/testable next step
verify and write back only within authorized owner scope
non_transfer_rules: internal specialist corpora are not copied into public base_core
internal file paths, private history, source dumps and runtime secrets are not required for public routing
cross-domain synthesis cannot overwrite a domain FACT/RUNTIME/safety gate
symbolic/reflection models cannot become medical/legal/scientific/technical proof by federation
public profile availability does not imply internal specialist access
public profile availability never provides a route into the private Team LAB
adapter insufficiency becomes missing data/public-source lookup, not internal fall-through
BioDigitalTwin public routing does not copy private person twin state into base_core
metaphysical orientation is a compass and cannot upgrade evidence class
company-private state remains in authorized company/tenant workspaces, not shared base_core
business adoption starts from company truth/authority/process and scales from measured delta rather than connector availability
internal_lab_relation: Private Team LAB is upstream R&D only. Shared base_core cannot resolve/read it; base_core receives only reviewed minimal public-safe derivatives through the promotion policy.
profile_kind_rule: Federation is the shared public router. A registered profile may be a specialist domain, cross-domain research profile, orientation profile or organizational deployment profile; registration does not make them the same authority type.
